subject.title: fix(agents): tighten lsSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the model-facing `ls.limit` contract intentionally reject fractional values that current releases accept?
rationale: The patch is a reasonable correctness tightening, but it is still a compatibility decision for an existing tool schema and repository policy requires owner-visible acceptance of such contract narrowing.

options.title: Accept integer-only contract
options.body: Approve the schema narrowing after the test targets the production schema and real runtime proof shows integer success plus fractional rejection.

options.title: Keep numeric compatibility
options.body: Leave the published schema permissive and normalize or truncate non-integer values in runtime logic if fractional model output must remain accepted.

recommendation.title: Accept integer-only contract
recommendation.body: Approve the schema narrowing after the test targets the production schema and real runtime proof shows integer success plus fractional rejection.
